sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of PC and Console Video Games via Digital Stores

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax or commercial registry distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic codified tradition; commercial, corporate and AML/CFT matters regulated by national statutes and supervised by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), DIAN and UIAF)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), particularly Articles 1, 5, 17, 22 and 45; Código de Comercio de Colombia (Decreto 410 de 1971), Book II; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (RUES regulations).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social via the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) online portal; tax registration processed with the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución e Inscripción en el Registro Único Empresarial (RUES); obtained through the Cámara de Comercio's virtual filing system.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is legally required for a Colombian S.A.S. Share capital may be subscribed and paid in installments as provided in the bylaws, and no escrow account is required; in-kind contributions must be paid immediately upon incorporation and be appraised by appropriate valuation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: MINUTES OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [S.A.S.]. The undersigned founding shareholders and board of directors, pursuant to the bylaws, adopt the following resolutions: (1) Share Subscription: all initial shares are approved, subscribed, and recorded in the shareholder register in accordance with the share subscription schedule; (2) Registered Office: the principal registered office is established as [address, city, Colombia], subject to RUES registration; (3) Officer Appointments: [Full Name] is appointed Representante Legal, [Full Name] is appointed Secretary, and [Full Name] is appointed Compliance Officer, each with the powers contained in Article [__] of the bylaws; (4) The officers are authorized to execute all filings before the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN. Resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Check and Pre-RUT Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (RUES online portal) and DIAN (Registro Único Tributario portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name availability request in RUES identifying no identical or confusingly similar registered company. Upon approval, request the pre-registration RUT from DIAN using the proposed corporate name, tax classification SAS (sociedad por acciones simplificada), and domicile. Save the pre-RUT number for the registration filing.
required_dossiers: Valid identification document of each founding shareholder (cédula de ciudadanía or passport)
Name availability certificate issued by the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected due to similarity, submit an alternative name within the same RUES session; if DIAN rejects the pre-RUT due to data inconsistency, correct the information and resubmit electronically within the DIAN portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Private Incorporation Instrument and Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders and legal representative (notarization optional unless real property contributions are involved)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute a private incorporation document containing the corporate name, domicile, object, capital structure, share classes, administration provisions, and internal governance rules. Sign the incorporation document and first board resolution in counterpart, or via electronically authenticated signature. If contributions include real estate, the incorporation document must be executed as a public deed before a notary and inscribed in the Registry of Public Instruments.
required_dossiers: Final text of the Documento Privado de Constitución
Proof of contribution (bank deposit receipt or asset valuation certificate, as applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If signatures are challenged or authenticity concerns arise, notarize signatures before a Colombian notary (firma ante notario) and refile the instrument; ensure all pages are initialed by each shareholder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration with the Cámara de Comercio via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social through the RUES online filing system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation document and supporting documents through RUES. Pay the applicable registration and inscription fee, which is computed by the Cámara based on authorized capital and applicable municipal tariff. Obtain the official certificate of commercial registration (certificado de existencia y representación legal) and request the assignment of the NIT by cross-filing with DIAN. The company is formally incorporated upon inscription.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución with original signatures
Identification documents of shareholders and appointed officers
Prueba del pago de tarifa (chamber fee receipt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RUES generates an administrative alert or a request for additional information, respond with corrected or completed documents within the chamber's stated term; if the entity faces an observation on capital formation, submit revised capital schedule and liability consent, then re-file through the same RUES case.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Post-Registration Corporate Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) and Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the NIT is assigned, update the RUT to reflect the definitive company data, tax classifications, head office, activity codes (ISIC 5820 / NAICS 511210), and obligation definitions. Open corporate bank account. Prepare, seal, and register official corporate books (share registry, minutes of shareholders, minutes of board, accounting ledger) before the Cámara de Comercio, as required by the Código de Comercio.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration certificate issued by the Cámara de Comercio
Cédula or passport of Representante Legal and compliance officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN requests supplementary documentation for the definitive RUT, upload the pending declarations or legal representative authorization in the DIAN portal; if chamber registration of books is queried, verify folio numbering and page counts, correct formats, and request new sealing date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Optional Notarization and Official Appointment Letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public, Cámara de Comercio, DIAN (as applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If any later corporate act or foreign shareholder on-boarding requires notarization, execute the relevant powers before a Colombian notary. Draft and issue the appointment letters for the Representante Legal, Secretary, and Compliance Officer, stating the scope of authority and validity under the S.A.S. bylaws. Record the appointment letters with the Cámara de Comercio if registration is required to bind third parties.
required_dossiers: Notarized copy of incorporation document (if notarization required)
Appointment letters of officers signed by shareholders or board
RUT certificate after final DIAN update
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is refused due to incomplete shareholder identification, cure by obtaining updated identification and witness certifications; if the chamber rejects the registered appointment letter, adjust the officer's acceptance signature and re-submit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing authority applies to ISIC 5820 (software/digital game publishing); the activity is not a regulated manufacturing or extraction industry.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No mandatory operating or manufacturing permit for pure digital publishing through Steam and PlayStation Store distribution channels.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA — Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (National Environmental Licensing Authority)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical production facility, no construction, and no discharge-generating industrial process; the activity is limited to digital storefront publishing and administrative operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A for the core activity; if a physical representative office or leasehold is occupied, comply with municipal solid waste management, sanitary sewer connection, and applicable Decreto 1076 de 2015 environmental quality standards. No wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste emissions are generated by game publishing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety, structural load, or workplace safety certification is required for pure remote digital publishing. If a physical office lease is used, obtain from the local fire authority (Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos) a technical fire safety concept and ensure compliance with Ley 1575 de 2012 and applicable municipal risk-management codes; the employer must also register in the Sistema de Gestión de la Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) with an ARL administrator if employees are engaged.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), Colombia — official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional platform: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Trámites Automatizados); electronic-invoicing clearance via DIAN web services/API.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the S.A.S. in the Chamber of Commerce and obtain the certificate of existence and legal representation. Step 2: The legal representative registers the company in the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) through MUISCA to obtain the NIT, electing the common VAT regime, corporate income tax and withholding obligations. Step 3: Acquire a DIAN-accepted digital signature certificate and activate the electronic-invoicing web service. Step 4: Receive the definitive NIT/RUT. Non-resident shareholders require no NIT for the S.A.S.; a non-resident foreign digital-service seller without a Colombian PE may use the simplified DIAN registration for foreign digital services and appoint a tax representative in Colombia.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists. Available elections/regimes: (i) consolidated taxation for 100%-held corporate groups authorized by DIAN (Art. 886 ET); (ii) Colombian Holding Company (CHC) regime for qualified foreign dividends and PE profits (Art. 895 ET); (iii) application for Free Trade Zone (Zona Franca) status with a reduced 25% income tax rate for exported services; (iv) anti-hybrid rules (Arts. 851-2 and 852-1 ET) denying deductions for hybrid arrangements with no elective override.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Impuesto al Valor Agregado (IVA), Law 1819/2016 as amended by Law 2277/2022
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No threshold for legal entities: VAT registration is mandatory from the first taxable transaction. Simplified (Régimen Simplificado) status is limited to natural persons with annual gross income below 3,500 UVT and total assets below 1,600 UVT; 2025 UVT = COP 49,799. Foreign digital-service suppliers must register from the first sale regardless of value.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta — FEV). Each invoice is generated in XML and transmitted to DIAN's validation web service through an authorized system (DIAN free software, proprietary software, or certified technology provider); DIAN immediately validates and applies the digital stamp (CUFE, Código Único de Facturación Electrónica), after which the seller delivers the XML to the buyer. Credit notes, debit notes, export invoices and electronic equivalent documents are submitted through the same API endpoints; no paper or non-cleared invoice is fiscally valid.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT is available under Art. 481 ET and Decree 2247/2014 where: (a) the contracting party and beneficiary of the digital publishing/licensing/distribution services (Steam/PlayStation Store) is a non-resident entity; (b) the digital game or licence is consumed exclusively outside Colombia; (c) the export service is evidenced by a DEX or a DIAN-validated CUFE electronic export invoice; and (d) the consideration is received and repatriated through Colombia's foreign-exchange market. Input VAT on development, marketing and commission costs remains creditable.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación — DEX) for physical media; for pure digital deliveries the DIAN-validated electronic export-service invoice with CUFE replaces the DEX
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill — required only when software is shipped physically (discs/cartridges); not applicable to digital Steam/PlayStation distribution
Inward Remittance Certificate — Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas with Declaración de Cambio modality 10 issued by the commercial bank, evidencing collection from the foreign store operator
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-checks every zero-rated export claim against Banco de la República foreign-exchange records and the bank's Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas. Non-repatriation, domestic consumption, irregular invoices, or invalid CUFE cause reversal of the 0% rate, retroactive assessment of 19% VAT plus moratory interest, the 100% inexactitude penalty (Art. 648 ET), the improper refund/compensation penalty (Art. 670 ET), cancellation of exporter status, and criminal liability of the legal representative for tax evasion under Art. 434B ET (imprisonment of 4–9 years).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) jointly with the Dirección de Cambios Internacionales (Foreign Exchange Department) and the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República; the foreign exchange regime is codified under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015 (Decreto Único Reglamentario del Sector Hacienda y Crédito Público), and Banco de la República Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia supervises authorized foreign exchange intermediaries (intermediarios del mercado cambiario).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a managed free float regime with full convertibility for current account transactions and registered capital account operations. Foreign investment for a SAS video game publisher (software publishing service exports) is generally freely convertible provided that: (i) the investment is registered with Banco de la República via the electronic International Investment Register (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales - el canal de inversión extranjera) for FDI statistics and future capital/dividend repatriation; (ii) all international payments are routed through an authorized Intermediary of the Exchange Market (banco comercial autorizado), never through unregulated parallel channels; (iii) remittances are documented with the applicable Declaración de Cambio (foreign exchange declaration) forms. Profit/dividend remittance by a Colombian SAS (ISIC 5820 digital publishing) is unrestricted up to 100% of registered after-tax profits, subject to: (a) standard corporate income tax of 35% for fiscal year 2025 under Ley 2277 de 2022 (tasa de renta), (b) the 5% additional dividend withholding tax for non-resident shareholders on post-CIT distributable profits (tasa de retención por dividendos: 10% + 5% surcharge under Ley 1819 de 2016), (c) presentation of the annual registry update proving the foreign shareholder's capital participation. No mandatory reinvestment quota or prudential freeze applies to software/Steam publishing operations. However, the SAS must channel the USD receipts from Valve or PlayStation Store into the Colombian banking system within the legal terms; the peso conversion rate is market-determined (TRM – Tasa Representativa del Mercado) and applies for tax and FX declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Colombian Foreign Exchange Regime (Resolución Externa 1/2018 del Banco de la República and Decree 1068/2015), proceeds from exports of services (including digital content distribution, Steam publishing royalties, and console store sales) must be channeled to the domestic economy through a Colombian authorized exchange intermediary. The statutory channeling period for service exporters is six (6) months computed from the date of issuance of the invoice or the contractual billing milestone, whichever is earlier, and must be documented via the Formulario Declaración de Cambio (Declaración de Cambio por servicios – código 5010 / 5011). Conversion of export proceeds into COP is mandatory if the funds are not retained in a foreign currency denominated deposit account (Cuenta en moneda extranjera) held in a Colombian banking institution. Practically, 100% of the USD receipts from Steam/Valve and PlayStation Store must be either: (i) settled into COP within 180 calendar days, or (ii) deposited into a registered USD account at a Colombian authorized bank and converted when used for operational expenses, with each conversion evidenced by exchange declarations. Foreign currency accounts (cuentas en moneda extranjera) must be opened exclusively with authorized intermediaries; transactions executed after the statutory timeline without channeling constitute exchange infractions (infracción cambiaria) under Article 18 of Law 9 of 1991, subject to fines equal to 100%-200% of the non-surrendered amount. For pure intangibles exported without physical customs documents, the export proceeds must be justified by the Elastic (ISIC) service invoices additionally evidencing the contract with Valve (Steamworks Distribution Agreement) and the platform statement of net revenue.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Corriente cliente internacional en USD (Cuenta corriente en moneda extranjera) + COP Operational Account; Capital Escrow Account, CID (Cuenta de Inversión Directa) as capital injection reception
Cuenta corriente en dólares / Cuenta de Ahorros en USD + Operational COP Account and Central Bank Foreign Investment Registration service desk
Cuenta de Ahorros en USD (Money Market USD) + COP Operating Account; Escrow-style settlement for foreign capital or royalty collection
Cuenta Corriente en COP with USD correspondent window; Capital Escrow Account for international FDI injections
COP Operational Account and Multi-divisa (USD) account; service account for Steam/console payouts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low-to-Medium. Colombian tax and FX regulations require all resident SAS transactions in foreign currency to be intermediated through (i) an authorized Colombian bank (intermediario del mercado cambiario) or (ii) an account in a foreign bank registered with Banco de la República as a Cuenta de Compensación. Offshore digital EMI platforms (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) are not authorized as standalone settlement channels for export proceeds without a local license. If used only as a secondary collection vehicle, they must (a) receive USD from Valve/PlayStation Store, (b) be linked as payout method to the Colombian SGD/Deceval-type settlement?; (c) the final USD must be transferred within 180 days into a Colombian authorized intermediary for FX purposes. The SEDPE (Sociedad Especializada en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos) regime (Ley 1735 de 2014 and Fintech Law Ley 2024 de 2020) licenses local payment institutions, but these do not have independent FX sales authorization unless they are officially authorized as foreign exchange intermediary; therefore, the treasury blueprint mandates a local Tier-1 bank for all foreign exchange filings, with EMIs used strictly as consolidated payout reporting (not legal clearing).
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors of a Colombian SAS may open corporate bank accounts remotely (digital onboarding) only if the legal representative is a resident or physically appoints a local representative; nevertheless, the bank’s due diligence program under Circular Básica Jurídica (C.E. 029 de 2014) mandates an in-person interview (entrevista de conocimiento del cliente) for higher-risk cross-border structures. For an SAS wholly owned by non-resident founders relating to virtual goods publishing, the standard approach is: (a) the foreign directors' identity must be apostilled and notarized overseas, (b) at least a qualified compliance meeting by video-conference is accepted by the SFC for tier-1 banks provided that advanced e-KYC biometric verification (biometría facial) with liveness detection is applied; (c) the bank generally still requires one physical visit to Bogotá by the legal representative from the beneficial owner (or a granted power of attorney to a Colombian resident CFO) at the moment of activating the capital escrow account and signing the accountholder contract. Statistically, for Steam publishing SAS, Banco de Bogotá and Davivienda accept remote opening when the KYC interview is conducted over an encrypted video call with two passport verification witnesses and a notarized sworn statement of beneficial ownership (declaración de beneficiario final). If remote is refused by the bank after review, the fallback option is a same-day registration at the notary in Bogotá for a special power (poder especial) granted to a certified local corporate secretary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Digital publishing revenue is intangible, high-volume cross-border payouts from US/EU platforms (Valve/PlayStation) with lack of physical commercial premises.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Original Steamworks Distribution Agreement / PlayStation Partner Marketing agreement, (ii) monthly Valve settlement statements and payout reports, (iii) DIAN RUT evidencing ISIC 5820, (iv) registered trademark and software copyright certificates, (v) annual audited financial statements or cash-flow matrix, (vi) detail of export invoice (factura de exportación) with service description and destination country, and (vii) Declaración de Cambio drafts filed with Banco de la República.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Non-resident beneficial owners residing in high-risk or off-shore jurisdictions, or multi-layer corporate ownership of the SAS.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Certified copy of the constitutional deed of the SAS (Escritura Pública) registered in Cámara de Comercio; (ii) IPO of direct/indirect beneficial owners (Certificado de Beneficiario Final); (iii) apostilled passports and utility bills (proof of address) for each UBO; (iv) bank and tax references from the home jurisdiction; (v) sworn statement of source of funds and wealth (justificación de fondos) for the initial capital injection; (vi) structured ownership chart showing no bearer shares or trusts hiding the economic interest; and (vii) legal opinion from home-country counsel confirming the corporate chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Unexpected concentration of USD receipts originating from a single foreign platform (Valve) producing week-end spikes inconsistent with ordinary operational liquidity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Set of executed agreements with Valve/PlayStation Store outlining the revenue-sharing model and the quarterly payment cycle; (ii) bank statements showing that received USB only funnel through to the registered foreign currency Colombian account; (iii) reconciliation report between VR (platform) net revenue and the SAS settlement; (iv) tax withholding certificates (recibo de pago de impuestos) and accountant's letter, and (v) annual fiscal compliance statement prepared by a Colombian CPA (Revisor Fiscal) confirming that every transaction is recorded in the SISHOGO of the DIAN.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Use of foreign corporate cards, prepaid balance or marketplace e-wallet (Steam Wallet) for domestic expenses or employee payroll.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) complete banking circularity showing that the SAS does not maintain untraceable e-wallets; (ii) declaration that all wage payroll is paid via bank transfer from the COP operational account; (iii) anti-fraud policy document; and (iv) issuance of monthly treasury report to the compliance officer proving the only cash outflows are legitimate operational payments and dividend remittance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections (FDI equity contributions) from non-resident shareholders into the Colombian SAS (CO__CO_SAS) must follow the mandatory bancarized route: (1) the shareholder wires USD from its home bank to the SAS's USD account at the Colombian Tier-1 intermediary (e.g., Banco de Bogotá account in USD with correspondent: Bank of America, New York or JPMorgan New York); (2) SWIFT MT103 reference must include the transaction narrative: 'Aporte social / capital increase CO__CO_SAS' plus the national tax ID (NIT) of the SAS; (3) within one (1) business day of collection the bank requires the Formulario No. 2 'Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Extranjera Directa Aporte de Capital' (DC – Inversión Directa, código 0151), accompanied by the certificate of incorporation (Cámara y Comercio), a SSS (Sociedad SAS) board/minutes approving the capital increase, and the foreign exchange broker's FX conversion order if converting into COP; (4) Registration of Constitutive Investment with Banco de la República (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) must be executed within the same month, producing a Registro individual report of the amount converted and the shares payable; (5) Retention: no Colombian withholding tax applies to capital injections (aportes), but stamp taxes (impuesto de timbre) at 0% for digitalized capital contributions for micro and small?; for the standard SAS no capital tax applies at entry. Use of a central US/local branch conversion is possible only through the bank's 'Mesa de dinero' for the official TRM; any delay beyond 30 days risks recategorization as overdue channeling subject to sanctions; if the injection exceeds USD 100,000 equivalently, the bank engages automatic reporting to UIAF (Inteligencia Financiera) triggering mandatory identification of the foreign shareholder's bank and source of wealth.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury flows for the SAS (royalty/license fees to developers, advertising purchases on Steam, payment for sub-license or content acquisition, commission remittances to publishers) use the following clearing rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 for all non-documentary payments denominated in USD/COP; (b) Commercial Documentary Letters of Credit (LC at sight) for payments tied to physical deliverables (e.g., boxed console media, specialized hardware), although for pure ISIC 5820 digital services the standard is a bank transfer against an electronic invoice; (c) COP wire through CUD (Cámara de Riesgo Central, now operated by Cámara de Compensación de Pagos) for domestic suppliers; and (d) SWIFT gpi (global payment innovation) to the beneficiary's bank for high-value royalties (>USD 1,000,000) guaranteeing same-day confirmation. Each MT103 must contain: purpose code '5210 Registro de regalías por uso de software / derechos de autor', the beneficiary NIT or international ID, and the reference 'Factura #xxxx con base en contrato de distribución'. Withholding tax obligations: the SAS must withhold US income tax at 33% on outbound royalties/rendering of services (Art. 408 E.T.) and remit the withholding to DIAN within the monthly preliminary tax term; for payments to US treaty counterparts, the limitation of benefits provisions under the US-Colombia Tax Treaty (2012) reduce source tax only if a valid Certificate of Tax Residency is attached before the disbursement date. FX cover: the SAS may buy USD spot from the Colombian bank at TRM + spread, and must complete the corresponding Declaración de Cambio de Servicios / Transferencia al exterior (Form TC-4) for each outward remittance; payments for third-party service imports are allowed freely, but outward royalties remitted to foreign related parties must satisfy the transfer pricing evidence file (Documentación Maestra y Local) to avoid double taxation and adverse adjustments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency Forwards (Forwards COP/USD) traded with Colombian authorized intermediaries, executed under ISDA/CMA/Formato Latinoaméricano, physically deliverable in COP or USD and permitted for hedging of the SAS's exporter proceeds; cannot be used for speculative accumulation beyond 110% of underlying cash flows.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) / Deliverable Forwards on USD/COP referenced to the TRM, allow hedging of projected Steam and PlayStation Store receivables without the need to hold USD; each NDF requires underlying exposure registration (contrato de cobertura) with Banco de la República.

Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS) between USD and COP, typically 1-3 year tenor, used to swap the USD-denominated revenue from Valve into COP liquidity for local payroll and DIAN tax payment; permitted exclusively for operational cover against FX mismatch, documented by the treasury policy of the SAS.

Plain Vanilla USD/COP Options (call or put) purchased from Tier-1 banks only (zero premium financing considered a violation of the cambio regime); must be declared to the exchange market and valued mark-to-market in the bank's system for Vigilancia financiera.
FX Swaps (Swap Cambiario) for short-term treasury rolling of the USD balance in a Cuenta en Foreign Currency into liquid COP for payroll at end of month without breaching the channeling deadline.

Commodity or multi-currency FX futures via a local clearing house are not permitted for the SAS due to the lack of a Colombian derivatives clearinghouse; all cleared derivatives must be registered with the Banco de la República's Electronic Derivatives Register (RDE) where the residency of the counterpart exceeds the 90-day term threshold.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación Anual de la Matrícula Mercantil — annual RUES commercial-registry renewal confirming registered office, legal representatives, directors, shareholders and ISIC activity codes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social / Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); for a Bogotá-registered S.A.S., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed calendar window from 1 January to 31 March of each year (not anniversary-based); no extensions, but late renewal is accepted with surcharges
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal after 31 March incurs a Chamber surcharge on the renewal tariff; two consecutive years without renewal leads to suspension and eventual administrative cancellation (strike-off) of the commercial registration, without dissolving the legal entity's underlying obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements approval and deposit — certified financial statements (Estados Financieros certificados), management report (Informe de Gestión) and statutory auditor's report (Dictamen del Revisor Fiscal) where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (electronic deposit through the Chamber of Commerce portal; Superintendencia de Sociedades only for entities under its surveillance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting (or written consent) approving the 31 December year-end statements by 31 March; deposit with the Chamber within one month after approval, in practice by 30 April of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades on the company and legal representative; the Chamber may refuse the matrícula renewal until the deposit is regularized; repeated non-deposit may trigger an intervention proceeding

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Form 110) — annual corporate income-tax return for the preceding fiscal year, required irrespective of taxable profit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (electronic filing via MUISCA portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual DIAN calendar published in December of the preceding year; for ordinary (non-large-taxpayer) S.A.S. entities the deadline falls in the second half of April, with exact day assigned by NIT last digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Sanción por extemporaneidad equal to 5% of the tax balance due for each month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due and subject to a minimum of 10 UVT; late-payment interest at approximately 1.5% monthly; continued non-filing triggers DIAN official assessment and coercive collection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Beneficiario Final — annual sworn statement of ultimate beneficial owners (natural persons with direct/indirect ownership of 5% or more or control) as at 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (electronic sworn declaration via MUISCA Beneficiario Final module)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual window fixed by DIAN resolution, typically in June following the taxation year (for fiscal year 2024 the filing period was 2-30 June 2025); exact date assigned by NIT last digit; interim updates are due within the declared calendar when a share transfer changes the beneficial owner
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: DIAN information-submission penalties under Estatuto Tributario Articles 651-652/658-3, scaled in UVT with a cap of 15,000 UVT per annual information package; corrective filings reduce but do not eliminate the sanction; general false-document criminal provisions apply to intentionally false sworn declarations

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (Revisor Fiscal) is required when the S.A.S. has more than 10 employees, or gross assets or gross annual income in the prior year exceed 3,000 UVT (1 UVT 2025 = COP 49,799; approx. COP 149.4 million / USD 36,000), or when the entity is placed under permanent surveillance by the Superintendencia de Sociedades; the articles of incorporation may require an auditor at a lower threshold
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Colombia under Decreto 2420/2015: default framework for a small/medium S.A.S. is Grupo 2 - IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para PYMES); full IFRS (Grupo 1) applies if the entity exceeds 30,000 UVT of assets or revenue, or is a public-interest entity; no local GAAP remains available for individual financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The legal representative submits the annual DIAN beneficial-owner declaration for the 31 December shareholding position; when a share transfer occurs during the year, the transfer must first be registered in the company's shareholders register book and the UBO declaration must be corrected/updated within the month following the transfer date; the annual calendar filing and any interim correction both fall under the same DIAN module

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250-800 per year (registered-office address in Bogotá/Medellín, virtual-office service and statutory-agent/legal-representative compliance support)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800-4,500 per year (external CPA firm engagement for certified financial statements and, when triggered, the Revisor Fiscal mandate with annual dictamen)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory CIT holiday for the PC/console video-game publishing sector. The standard 35% rate applies to Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas (S.A.S.). Available incentives include an additional 25% deduction for qualifying research, development, and innovation (I+D+i) expenditure under Article 256-1 of the Colombian Tax Code; a reduced tax rate for entities located in certified Free Trade Zones; and the ordinary deduction for VAT paid on capital goods. No preferential rate applies to Steam/PlayStation publishing royalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 - Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Sociedades y Asimiladas). Filed electronically through the DIAN 'Módulo de Renta' within the Muisca / Servicios Informáticos platform.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline is set annually by DIAN Resolution based on the last two digits of the NIT (tax ID). For a calendar-year S.A.S., the statutory window generally falls between the 8th and 20th day of April following the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the twelve-month period for which the corporate income tax return is filed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the calendar year in which the Steam/PlayStation publishing income was accrued. A Colombia S.A.S. must use a 1 January - 31 December period; no special fiscal-year election is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenues from software sales, digital store payouts, royalties, and related publishing activities before deducting platform commissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the full payout from Steam Valve and PlayStation Store as gross receipts; platform commissions, payment processor fees, and refunds are deductible as costs or expenses when properly documented and subject to transfer pricing if paid to a related party.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Other revenues outside the ordinary software publishing activity, such as interest, foreign-currency gains, and asset sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include exchange-rate gains from foreign-currency payouts and any incidental interest income. These amounts are subject to the same normal corporate tax collection and must be taxed at 35%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs allocable to generating the publishing revenue, including platform commissions, top-up licenses, Steam Direct distribution fees, audiovisual asset purchases, and local hosting costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Keep contemporaneous accounting, e-invoices, and payment support showing the business purpose of each cost. Payments to related foreign parties must comply with the arm's length standard and be supported by a local transfer pricing study where applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses allowed as tax deductions, including salaries, royalties paid to software developers, marketing, office leases, and R&D expenditures.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Limit deductions to expenses that are necessary, proportionate, and causally linked to Colombian-source publishing operations. Baggage handling of related-party management fees without substance in the payee may be challenged by DIAN.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after deduction of allowable costs, expenses, tax-free items, and tax-loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident shareholders, this figure determines the basis of the 35% headline CIT. Tax loss carryforwards from prior years may offset only up to 25% of taxable income for a period not exceeding 12 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax liability obtained by applying the statutory 35% rate to the net taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The standard 35% rate applies; no gross-income alternative for a Colombian-resident S.A.S. Additional surtaxes apply only to entities engaged in the oil, mining, and electricity sectors, not to software publishing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty (Article 641 ET): 5% of the tax due per month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax, with a minimum penalty of 10 UVT. Failure to file (Article 714 ET): 20% of the tax assessed. Late payment interest (Article 635 ET): monthly default interest of approximately 1.5% (calculated using the effective benchmark lending rate). Inaccurate or fraudulent reporting can trigger a correction surcharge of up to 200% of the omitted tax under Article 647 ET.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief on dividends, the non-resident shareholder must provide the Colombian paying company with: (i) a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the competent authority of the treaty jurisdiction covering the dividend payment date; (ii) a declaration of beneficial ownership stating that the shareholder is not acting as an intermediary; and (iii) sufficient information to allow the S.A.S. to complete the DIAN informative annexes. The reduced treaty rate (generally 5% for a direct qualifying shareholding or 10% otherwise) is applied at source by the withholding agent; no prior DIAN approval is required, but the TRC and supporting declaration must be retained for at least five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP/software licenses from a Colombian S.A.S. to a non-resident: statutory withholding tax 15% on gross; where the payment is considered a technical service, a 15% rate equally applies. Interest on cross-border debt: statutory withholding tax 15% on gross payments to non-residents, with a reduced 10% rate under most DTAs and 5% for certain bank financing. Treaty relief requires the same TRC and beneficial-owner protocol as dividends.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and Master File thresholds are referenced to UVT (Unidad de Valor Tributario). For 2024, 1 UVT equals COP 47,065; therefore 30,000 UVT equals approximately COP 1,411,950,000. A Colombian S.A.S. must prepare and file the Local File and transfer pricing declaration when its gross income or total assets exceed this threshold and it engages in cross-border related-party transactions (e.g., intercompany royalties, management fees, or platform payout structures). Master File is required when the multinational group has consolidated global revenues above 600,000 UVT and meets the OECD transfer pricing documentation criteria.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not have a bespoke offshore Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) regime separate from its general tax code. However, DIAN applies substance-oriented controls under the general anti-abuse rule (Article 869 ET), the permanent establishment concept, and the controlled foreign corporation (CFC) rules. A Colombian S.A.S. must demonstrate actual local economic activity - employees, office, decision-making, and business risk - to avoid re-characterization as a shell conduit for foreign shareholders. Non-resident digital publishers arranging a structurally passive Colombian entity without meaningful functions should expect PE and GAAR challenges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting Steam/PlayStation payouts, recording fictitious platform refunds, inflating deductible costs, or using false invoices from shell trading companies to reduce the Colombian corporate income tax base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 647 ET, DIAN may impose a penalty of 200% of the omitted tax, plus default interest under Article 635 ET. Criminal tax evasion under Article 425 of the Colombian Criminal Code carries imprisonment of 4 to 9 years and fines equal to the same amount as the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who sign fraudulent returns or approve falsified accounts are jointly and severally liable for the omitted tax, may face civil restitution, and may receive court-ordered travel bans pending criminal proceedings. Active participation in evasion can lead to personal criminal conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the transfer pricing declaration and Local File when thresholds are met, or setting intercompany royalties, platform commissions, or management fees at non-arm's length rates purely to drain Colombian taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN is empowered to adjust the transfer price to the arm's length value, increasing the taxable base and the CIT liability. The same adjustment carries a penalty of up to 5% of the adjusted value or 20% of the underpaid tax, plus default interest; absence of a contemporaneous TP study triggers a mandatory penalty equal to 3% of the value of the affected transactions, not less than 30,000 UVT? (in line with Article 260(8) ET).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who directly negotiate and approve related-party agreements without obtaining a proper arm's length economic study expose themselves to joint liability for the resulting tax assessment and interest. Criminal liability can attach if the transfer pricing documentation is knowingly fabricated to hide a constructive dividend.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating a Colombian S.A.S. merely as a nominal entity to hold Steam/PlayStation payouts while all substantive decisions, employees, IP ownership, and contractual negotiations remain abroad, with operations conducted in terrorism of the Colombian tax domicile.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the legal personality of the shell S.A.S. under GAAR (Article 869 ET), reallocate the income to the foreign principals, and impose a penalty equal to up to 100% of the tax avoided. The entity may also be characterized as a permanent establishment of the foreign shareholder, subjecting both the entity and the foreign parent to Colombia-source taxation and registration obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors who consent to the use of the corporate vehicle without actual substance can be held personally liable for the tax reassessment, have their assets attached by DIAN, and may face a travel ban during fraud investigation. In serious cases, the criminal filing of false constitutional documents triggers imprisonment for 3 to 7 years for documentary falsification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving recurring payouts from Steam Valve or PlayStation's foreign payment processors into a Colombian bank account while the entity has no corresponding development staff, no counters, and a disproportionately high volume compared to its declared business activity, or structuring small deposits to frustrate financial disclosure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Financial institutions must report suspicious transactions to the Financial Information and Analysis Unit (UIAF). Non-compliance or active structuring may result in account freezing, administrative fines under the Colombian AML regime up to 1,000 UVT per infraction, and criminal money laundering charges under Article 323 of the Criminal Code carrying 10 to 15 years' imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly bypass bank due-diligence requests or orchestrate layered payments through shell accounts face criminal conviction, personal civil liability for the proceeds, asset freezing, and pretrial detention with travel bans. Directors protecting the foreign principal in laundering software-publishing royalties can be tried as co-authors of the offense.
